title: A line of supervisor.jsonl
description: One action of the supervisor (orch conduct supervise|reap) on a run, appended to <run>/supervisor.jsonl with fsync before the next step: what it saw (health, reason_code), what it did (action) and why. The same action is an info line SUPERVISOR_* of progress.jsonl and an orch.conductor.health event.

health.description: The class of health.classify the supervisor acted on.

reason_code.description: Reason code of the class (HEARTBEAT_STALE, RUN_ORPHANED, ...), null when it has none.

action.description: notify: only said; snapshot: the evidence was written before a signal; stop: the hung conductor was stopped; reap: orphaned role groups were stopped and their agent records closed; resume: a detached `conduct resume` was started; given_up: the breaker is open, the run is left to the owner; identity_mismatch: the lease owner is not the process with that pid, nothing was signalled; busy: a live owner holds the run, nothing was done.

pid.description: Process id the action concerns (the conductor stopped, the resume started).

signal.description: The last signal sent to pid.
